_readme: Per-host FETCH policy for scripts/build_corpus.py (read via scripts/host_policy.py). A 'suspended' host is never requested by the loader — neither as a registry URL nor as any redirect hop (DOI resolvers, download/CDN links, the curl fallback): its registry rows are skipped without a manifest failure row, do not age toward pruning, and prune_corpus leaves its existing rows (including documents already held) untouched. A host covers its subdomains. This is a fetch suspension, not a corpus exclusion — use registry/eligibility.json for that. Every backend listed must be disabled (check_contracts).

escholarship.org.reason: policy: CloudFront refuses an identified bot UA; browser impersonation is WAF avoidance (Codex 2026-09-24); resume only if an honest identity or an explicitly permitted API/download route works

mdpi.com.reason: network wall: MDPI answers a host-wide HTTP 403 to both requests and curl from this operator's network (re-probed 2026-08-28; until 2026-09-25 documented only as find_sources.PAUSED_PDF_HOSTS and prune_corpus.TRANSIENT_403_HOSTS). Content is often CC BY; resume only if an honest client is served again

ssrn.com.reason: policy: SSRN (papers.ssrn.com, reached via doi.org/10.2139 redirects) answers HTTP 403 through a Cloudflare challenge from this network (observed 2026-09-25); WAF or browser workarounds are forbidden and SSRN records state 'All rights reserved'. SSRN-origin works are registered only through a separately licensed copy on another host

lovdata.no.reason: policy: lovdata.no and api.lovdata.no robots.txt 'User-agent: * Disallow: /' (verified 2026-09-25); the NLOD public-data dumps are not requested. Compliance programme (Codex decision 2026-09-25): pointer only

eur-lex.europa.eu.reason: access control: eur-lex.europa.eu answers every request, robots.txt included, with an AWS WAF challenge (HTTP 202, empty body; verified 2026-09-25); the same EU documents are collected from the Publications Office Cellar (find_eurlex)

ghgprotocol.org.reason: policy: GHG Protocol terms of use forbid 'any robot, spider, rover, scraper ... to ... copy' the Services (verified 2026-09-25), including its two CC BY publications; pointer only

fsb-tcfd.org.reason: policy: TCFD website terms forbid accessing or copying content 'using any robot, spider, scraper, web crawler or other automated means' (verified 2026-09-25); FSB-hosted copies on www.fsb.org are the reviewed route

buildingsmart.org.reason: policy: buildingSMART websites' robots.txt carry 'Content-Signal: ai-train=no' for all agents (express DSM Art. 4 reservation) and Disallow: / for ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/GPTBot/CCBot (verified 2026-09-25); official GitHub repository copies are a separate reviewed route

globalreporting.org.reason: policy: GRI website terms prohibit 'any automated systems (robots, spiders)' and the standards download sits behind a registration form (verified 2026-09-25); pointer only

sasb.ifrs.org.reason: policy: sasb.ifrs.org robots.txt 'Disallow: /*.pdf$' for all agents plus a download form (verified 2026-09-25); pointer only

cdp.net.reason: policy: CDP terms section 15 'No text or data mining' and a robot/scraper ban (verified 2026-09-25); pointer only

coclass.byggtjanst.se.reason: access control: login required and robots.txt 'Disallow: /' (verified 2026-09-25); pointer only
